svg.text: Two height bands. One observation pose.
3D schematics of the geometric tests used during view-pose selection
Count returns in each 0.15 m XY cell.
Illustrative candidates around an annotated target.
B Rejected: blocked XY sight mask
C Selected: position + yaw + viewing elevation
Ground arrows: yaw toward Target XY. Camera anchors: illustrative.
h is relative to estimated local ground. Each band flags a cell at ≥2 returns; bounds are strict.
Illustrative geometry, uncalibrated optics. Below threshold does not establish safe passage or a clear view.
Line of sight (LOS) uses a planar mask. FOV = field of view. Some fallbacks relax LOS.
